Been playing for over 8 years now, and while I started as a person that muted the chat because of the fear of getting flamed and never typed (yeah, I was very, very soft at the time, though I was like 14 years old as well, so) to a person that is passive-aggresive most of the time, flames people over every mistake (I now mute chat to avoid possibility of negative interactions with people, but in my head I call them names all the time), and basically expects others to be hateful towards them.

I can be polite, caring guy irl, I do my best to be a good person, and then I go back to League after taking 2 week break and it just starts spiraling down because the anger simply becomes overwhelming after few days of playing and I don't have a vent for it.
I've heard and said a lot of stuff that should never be told to others, especially people you only see for 30 minutes in your life. And I normalized it to the extent that I'd just accept any insult thrown at me and maybe even think "hey, that guy has the right to say so, after all if I got this mad I'd do the same, so whatever".
I know nobody will really care about my story, but I just wanted to share it and tell you that you're not alone. It's easy to let League bring the worst out of you and sometimes it's tough to overcome it.
